catalogue.name: The Army of the Republic(s)
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Infantry Platoon
sharedRules.description:
0-1x Fire support squad - deploy separately
2-3x infantry squad  - deploy separately. the infantry platoon counts as 1 core choice for each infantry squad it includes.

sharedRules.name: Attach(any regular unit)
sharedRules.description: Model may attach to any regular unit before game, becoming part of the unit for all purposes. When allocating wounds, this model is exempt from the “wounded models take precedence” rule.

sharedRules.name: ATGM Launcher
sharedRules.description: Model has 1x ATGM.

sharedRules.name: Line
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Fire for effect!: attack any enemy unit with 1x Fire mission; this attack counts as indirect.
● Fix Bayonets!: all friendly unarmed regular units get CC (2) until end of turn.
● Hit the dirt!: use after attack is declared but before dice is rolled. One (1) friendly regular unit gets » 1 action marker, Cover(2 or +1) and Tough(6) vs ranged until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Flak MG
sharedRules.description: Model has Flak.

sharedRules.name: Company Commander
sharedRules.description: The company commander counts as attached to its own unit.

sharedRules.name: Tank Ace
sharedRules.description: Upgrade any Battle tank or Assault tank: it gets Robust(1), Leader(1), Communications.

sharedRules.name: Mechanized
sharedRules.description:
1x Battle Tank or Assault Tank does not count as a special choice.
All regular units must enter the field embarked on a transport unless they have Cargo(no).

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Strike from March: one (1) friendly vehicle unit has Move(+3, max 12) until end of turn if it enters the board at the friendly board edge(s) midpoint.
● Redundancies: force opponent to re-roll a Vehicle Damage Table result.
● Drilled dismount: use when a friendly unit disembarks a ground vehicle. It has Cover(2) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Light (guerrilla/airborne)
sharedRules.description:
1x Recon Squad or Walker Platoon does not count as a special choice.
May not field Conscripts, Battle/Assault tank, Artillery vehicle or Republic IFV.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Advance Patrol: use before game. One (1) Veteran Squad gets Infiltrate or Insertion.
● One with the land: one (1) friendly regular unit in cover has Target(potshots) vs ranged attacks until it attacks or leaves cover. It cannot receive this bonus twice in the same terrain piece.
● Find the Path: all friendly regular units get Move(nimble) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Trenchers
sharedRules.description:
1x Assault Engineers or Fire Support Squad does not count as a special choice.
May not field Aircraft, VTOL, Republic IFV or Republic armoured car.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● We have been here before: use before game. Deploy up to 12” of trench onto the board.
● Hull down: use when a friendly vehicle starts in or moves into or a terrain feature that would provide cover to regular units. It gets Robust(1) until it moves.
● Multipurpose shovels: one (1) friendly unarmed regular unit gets CC (2), hit(+1 vs unarmed), wound(+1) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Understand weakness
sharedRules.description: Cancel any enemy FP use on 5+

sharedRules.name: Attach(any infantry or veteran squad)
sharedRules.description: Model may attach to any infantry or veteran squad before game, becoming part of the unit for all purposes. When allocating wounds, this model is exempt from the “wounded models take precedence” rule.

sharedRules.name: Traps
sharedRules.description: Moving through this unit counts as dangerous terrain.

sharedRules.name: Supply source: Dump
sharedRules.description:
Sacrifice 1 wound from the Supply Dump to give one other friendly regular unit within 9” one of the following effects:
» Medical Support until end of turn.
» masterwork for one (1) attack.
» When attacking, 1 model may attack with any support weapon instead of its normal weapon.

sharedRules.name: Supply source: Porter
sharedRules.description:
Sacrifice 1 porter to give one other friendly regular unit within 9” one of the following effects:
» Medical Support until end of turn.
» masterwork for one (1) attack.
» When attacking, 1 model may attack with any support weapon instead of its normal weapon.

sharedRules.name: Missile Launch
sharedRules.description: As a full action, deploy 1x cruise missile in staging, one use.

sharedRules.name: Detonation
sharedRules.description: Use as an attack. All units suffer a wound(+2) hit for each wound it has within 9” of this model, cover applies. Closest enemy model within 1” suffers wound(+8) hits instead. Remove model after attack.

sharedRules.name: Transport glider
sharedRules.description: Note that gliders generally land further from enemy troops. This would represent a more desperate landing. Robustness comes from lack of vulnerable parts.

sharedRules.name: Coordinate forces
sharedRules.description: +1 FP at end of turn on 5+

sharedRules.name: Bestow Scoring(+2) (6”, closest non-simple vehicle)
sharedRules.description: Closest non-simple vehicle within 6" counts as size +2 for scoring objectives.

sharedRules.name: Skyhook Capacity
sharedRules.description: Capacity(1 container or max Defence(9) ground vehicle, open)

sharedRules.name: Supply
sharedRules.description: Replace with Supply Drop (see Republic light doctrine units) after debarkation.

sharedRules.name: Combat armour
sharedRules.description: Defence(5)
